references.text: Describes how Aaron and his sons were to be anointed and consecrated for priestly service, using the expression 'fill their hand' which means to ordain for service.
Describes the anointing of Aaron with the anointing oil, which made him the anointed priest.
Contains the expression 'fill their hand', referring to the consecration of Aaron and his sons to the priesthood.
Refers to the anointing of Aaron and his sons to sanctify them for priestly service.
Describes the actual anointing of Aaron with the anointing oil on his head.
Tells of the anointing of both Aaron and his sons with the anointing oil to sanctify them.
Names Aaron's sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, who are also mentioned in the context of Num 3:2.
States that no one takes upon themselves the honor of being high priest, but must be called by God, as Aaron was.
